cohort: The study recruited 120 mother-newborn pairs from whom maternal venous blood samples were taken on admission to the labor ward and newborn venous blood samples were drawn from the placental part of the umbilical cord.
finding: Correlation between umbilical cord and maternal adiponectin, IL-6, and TNF-a levels was low, although significant correlations were found between umbilical cord adiponectin and maternal BDNF/maternal adiponectin, and between maternal leptin and maternal TNF-a.
cross-section timing: Maternal blood samples were taken on admission to the labor ward, and newborn blood samples were drawn from the placental part of the umbilical cord.
